title: EU Tech Push Boosts Ultrafast Laser Startups
summary: Several startups see a big opportunity to build the next generation of ultrafast lasers, a crucial component in high-end chip manufacturing, in Europe. In June 2026, the European Commission proposed legislation and strategies to reinforce Europe’s competitiveness and independence in the semiconductor and AI ecosystems.
